g.textArea: DSD_DSnD (packs) and Dist_DSnD (cases): average demand, minus stock on hand, gives what to bake each day.

rect.data-description: FORMULA (this sheet). =TODAY(). Display.
INPUT (typed). Typed planning Sunday, 2026-09-20. Sheet note: update this date in every new template.
FORMULA (this sheet). H3 =H2-6 = 9/14, then one day per column to 9/19. The demand formulas step back 0, 7, 14, 21 days from these.
INPUT (typed). Typed 1.2. Multiplies every DSD _Demand.
FORMULA (this sheet). =IF(WEEKDAY(TODAY(),1)=7,1,WEEKDAY(TODAY(),1)) = 6 (Friday). Saturday counts as 1. Feeds: Dist_DSnD bridge columns DC:DE.

LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Planned bags and hours read back from Mix-Slice-Oven. Sunday: W1 ='Mix-Slice-Oven'!AD1 = 48 Breadline bags, W2 ='Mix-Slice-Oven'!BD1 = 8.5 h, W3 MCS bags 174, W4 MCS hours 16.08.
FORMULA (this sheet). H283 =SUM(SUMIFS(Dist_DSnD[Sun/Mon],Dist_DSnD[Asset],{"Breadline","Breadline/Artisan"})) = 78; H284 MCS LINE = 1146; H285 total = 1224 (Sun/Mon cases).

LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Formula: =LET(no,Products[No.],grp,Products[Gen. Prod. Posting Group],ast,IFERROR(Products[Asset],""),keep,((grp="FG"))*(ast<>"Charges / Fees"),SORTBY(FILTER(no,keep),FILTER(grp,keep),1)). FG only.
FORMULA (this sheet). Formula: =A8.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Formula: =XLOOKUP([@Sku],Products[No.],Products[Asset]). Feeds: 3rd-party demand branch, Thursday rule.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Formula: =XLOOKUP([@Sku],Products[No.],Products[Gen. Prod. Posting Group]). Display.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Formula: =VLOOKUP([@Sku],Mix_Slice_Oven[Sku],1,FALSE). Presence check: #N/A means the item is not on Mix-Slice-Oven (third party).
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Formula: =XLOOKUP([@Sku],Products[No.],Products[Weight]). Display.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Despite the name, it holds the description: =XLOOKUP([@Sku],Products[No.],Products[Description]). Feeds: Dist_DSnD bridge description.

LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Average packs sold on the same weekday over 4 weeks; 3rd Party and 3rd Party - Bake use the sample week only. Sun/Mon: =LET(q,SalesHistory[Quantity],s,SalesHistory[No.],d,SalesHistory[Posting Date],k,[@Sku],a,[@Asset],IF(OR(a="3rd Party",a="3rd Party - Bake"),SUMIFS(q,s,k,d,H$3),AVERAGE(MAP({0,7,14,21},LAMBDA(o,SUMIFS(q,s,k,d,H$3-o)))))). Columns: H Sun/Mon (sample Mon 9/14) to M Fri/Sat (Sat 9/19).
NOT USED. Week 0 and Week 1 are blank. Week 2 holds typed numbers (for example 280). No formula reads them.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Repeated per day block (Sun Q:W, Mon X:AD, Tue AE:AK, Wed AL:AR, Thu AS:AY, Fri AZ:BF). S_Sku =[@Sku]; M_Desc =XLOOKUP([@Sku],Products[No.],Products[Description]).
INPUT (typed). Typed per day. All blank. Floor already includes the freezer count, so typing here double counts.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). That day's stock on hand. Sunday: =SUMIFS(Sunday[Total],Sunday[Code],[@Sku]); Monday reads Monday[Total], and so on.
FORMULA (this sheet). Sunday: =ROUNDUP(([@Sun/Mon]*$C$5),0). Mon uses Mon/Tue, Tue uses Tue/Wed, Wed uses Wed/Thur, Fri uses Fri/Sat.
FORMULA (this sheet). =IF([@Asset]<>"MCS LINE",ROUNDUP(([@Thur/Fri]*$C$5)+([@Fri/Sat]*$C$5),0),ROUNDUP(([@Thur/Fri]*$C$5),0)). Lines other than MCS also bake Friday's (Fri/Sat) demand on Thursday.
FORMULA (this sheet). =([@S_Freeze]+[@S_Floor])-[@S_Demand] (Sunday column is spelled S_Balanace).
FORMULA (this sheet). =[@S_Balanace]. Negative = packs to bake. Feeds: DoughWeight Sun to Fri, Mix_Slice_Oven K and _Needed, Oven_Info Demand.
NOTE. Sun/Mon avg 17.5: S_Demand ROUNDUP(21.0) = 21, Floor 79, Balance 58, nothing to bake. Thursday: ROUNDUP(27.75 x 1.2 + 9.5 x 1.2) = 45. Friday: Floor 0, Demand 12, Production -12, bake 12.

LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Formula: =LET(no,Products[No.],grp,Products[Gen. Prod. Posting Group],ast,IFERROR(Products[Asset],""),keep,((grp="FG-DIST"))*(ast<>"Charges / Fees"),SORTBY(FILTER(no,keep),FILTER(grp,keep),1)). FG-DIST only.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Sku =A287. Asset =XLOOKUP([@Sku],Mix_Slice_Oven[Sku],Mix_Slice_Oven[Asset]) (from Mix-Slice-Oven, not Products).
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Holds the description: =XLOOKUP([@Sku],Products[No.],Products[Description]).

LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Imported from the external file's own Supply and Demand sheet: =VLOOKUP([@Sku],'[1]Daily Supply & Demand'!$E$249:$L$374,3,FALSE) (column 3 to 8). No buffer, no 4-week average here.
FORMULA (this sheet). =[@0_StillNeeded], then 1_StillNeeded and 2_StillNeeded.

FORMULA (this sheet). Same layout as DSD (Sun Q:W, Mon X:AD, Tue AE:AK, Wed AL:AR, Thu AS:AY, Fri AZ:BF). _Freeze and _Floor are never filled, so _Demand =[@Sun/Mon], _Balance = -Demand and _Production = -Demand. Feeds DoughWeight for F5 SKUs.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). 0_Sun to 0_Sat: =SUMIFS(SalesOrders[Quantity],SalesOrders[No.],[@0_Sku],SalesOrders[Shipment Date],BI$284). The dates are row 284.

LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Total =SUM(Dist_DSnD[[#This Row],[0_Sun]:[0_Sat]]). Inventory = today's day-table Total: =IFERROR(LET(k,[@0_Sku],d,IF(WEEKDAY(TODAY())=7,1,WEEKDAY(TODAY())),CHOOSE(d,XLOOKUP(k,Sunday[Code],Sunday[Total]),XLOOKUP(k,Monday[Code],Monday[Total]),XLOOKUP(k,Tuesday[Code],Tuesday[Total]),XLOOKUP(k,Wednesday[Code],Wednesday[Total]),XLOOKUP(k,Thursday[Code],Thursday[Total]),XLOOKUP(k,Friday[Code],Friday[Total]))),"0")

FORMULA (this sheet). =[@0_TotalOrders]-[@0_Inventory]. Today =CHOOSE(WEEKDAY(TODAY()),[@Sun/Mon],[@Mon/Tue],[@Tue/Wed],[@Wed/Thur],[@Thur/Fri],[@Fri/Sat],[@Sun/Mon]). 0_1stShift and 0_2ndShift are blank typed columns.

FORMULA (this sheet). Meant for the next two weeks, but they still read the 0_ SKU and 0_ totals: 1_Sun =SUMIFS(SalesOrders[Quantity],SalesOrders[No.],[@0_Sku],SalesOrders[Shipment Date],BX$284); 1_TotalOrders =SUM(Dist_DSnD[[#This Row],[0_Sun]:[0_Sat]]).
FORMULA (this sheet). CZ =IF(LEFT([@Sku],2)="F5","F"&MID([@Sku],3,10),"N/A - not a case code"). DA looks the pack up on DSD_DSnD, then Dist_DSnD.

rect.data-title: Today's DSD balance, next 2 days' demand (DC:DE)
rect.data-description: LOOKUP (other sheet or table). DC =IFERROR(XLOOKUP($C287,DSD_DSnD[Sku],CHOOSE($DT$2,DSD_DSnD[S_Balanace],DSD_DSnD[M_Balance],DSD_DSnD[T_Balance],DSD_DSnD[W_Balance],DSD_DSnD[TH_Balance],DSD_DSnD[F_Balance])),""). DD and DE read _Demand for the next two days (MOD on DT2).

FORMULA (this sheet). Column1 =IF($DA287="No match found (primary or 3rd party)","(Case Only)",$CZ287). Column2 =IF($C287="(Case Only)","(Case Only)",IF(OR($DC287="",$DD287="",$DE287=""),"No DSD bread available",IF($DC287>($DD287+$DE287),$DC287-($DD287+$DE287),"No DSD bread available"))). Column3 =IF($D287="No DSD bread available","No DSD bread available",IF($D287="(Case Only)","(Case Only)",ROUNDDOWN($D287/XLOOKUP($F287,'Critical Lookup Information'!$Q:$Q,'Critical Lookup Information'!$S:$S),0)))

OUTPUT. PivotTable on SalesOrders, filtered to DIST: items down, shipment date, customer and order across, Outstanding Quantity summed. Last refreshed 2026-09-18. C2 pallet: =XLOOKUP(C$6,'Critical Lookup Information'!$A:$A,'Critical Lookup Information'!$B:$B).

rect.data-title: Stored table formulas differ from the cells
rect.data-description: ISSUE. DSD_DSnD Asset, Gen. Prod., Dough Weights and the six demand columns: the table's stored formula is older (points at Mix-Slice-Oven, the Items List, or drops the 3rd-party branch). Extending or refilling the table brings the old logic back.

ISSUE. DSD_DSnD Avg of Previous 4, S_Sku, S_Desc, T_Sku, T_Desc; Dist_DSnD Column3; Mix_Slice_Oven Unique Dough, Asset, Scrap Factor, Sku, Description, Planned Total, T_Optimal; Oven_Info Daily Bags Per Mix, Finished Product. New rows come in blank.
ISSUE. Sku and all six demand averages (H264:M264 = 48) are typed numbers, not formulas.
ISSUE. For lines other than MCS, TH_Demand includes Fri/Sat and F_Demand includes it again.
ISSUE. Row 284 dates are text (for example 8/31/2026), so SUMIFS never matches a Shipment Date. Distribution order visibility is zero.
ISSUE. They sum SalesOrders for 0_Sku against their own dates, and TotalOrders, Inventory and StillNeeded point at the 0_ columns.
ISSUE. _Floor is the day table's Total, which already includes the freezer count.

rect.data-title: Dist has no buffer and no stock
rect.data-description: ISSUE. Dist demand skips C5, and Dist _Freeze and _Floor are never filled, so every case in demand is baked again even when cases are on hand.
ISSUE. 'Avg of Previous 4 Same Weekdays' and 'TOTAL Cases' hold descriptions; Week 2 holds constants; Column1 to Column4 are unnamed; S_Balanace is misspelled.
ISSUE. Pivot last refreshed 2026-09-18 and row 3 is #REF! (C3 points at a deleted range).

H3:M3 sample dates"]:::input AVG["Demand H:M
average of 4 same weekdays
3rd party: 1 week only"]:::calc C5["C5 buffer 1.2"]:::input DEM["_Demand = ROUNDUP(avg x 1.2)
Thursday non-MCS adds Fri/Sat"]:::calc DAYS["Sunday to Friday Total"]:::lookup FLOOR["_Floor"]:::lookup FRZ["_Freeze
typed, blank"]:::input BAL["_Balance =
Freeze + Floor - Demand"]:::calc PRD["_Production = Balance

no buffer"]:::lookup DPRD["Dist _Production = - Demand"]:::calc SO["Open Sales Lines"]:::export GRID["Order grids 0_ 1_ 2_"]:::calc CLI["Critical Lookup
packs per case"]:::input BR["Case to pack bridge
spare DSD packs / packs per case"]:::calc OUT["DoughWeights, Mix-Slice-Oven,
Oven_Info"]:::calc MSO["Mix-Slice-Oven rows 1-2
bags and hours"]:::lookup SH --> AVG H2 --> AVG AVG --> DEM C5 --> DEM DAYS --> FLOOR FLOOR --> BAL FRZ --> BAL DEM --> BAL BAL --> PRD PRD --> OUT EXTD --> DDEM DDEM --> DPRD DPRD --> OUT SO --> GRID DAYS -->|"today"| GRID BAL -->|"today, DT2"| BR CLI --> BR MSO -.->|"W1:W4 per day"| PRD
